text:
Ana: Quick design check — uploaded new catalog mocks here: https://redwood.mock/snap/abc123. Two soft asks: 1) chips behavior for active filters on compact/compare views (merge into one pill with counts vs keep separate chips and overflow into a "+N" menu), 2) performance badge copy and tooltip wording (p50/p95 vs "Typical"/"Worst").
Matt: Nice — the compact row is tight. If we merge chips into a single pill we lose immediate context for which filters are active. prefer separate chips with overflow.
Jordan: Agree with Matt. Users scan quickly; separate chips + an overflow node keeps visibility. Could we collapse visually after 5 chips to keep density?
Leah: For keyboard users, collapsed +N needs to be reachable via tab and expose list items with proper roles. Also aria label for the overflow should list filters e.g., `aria-label="filters: model family x, quantized, short-context"`.
Carson: On badges — current mock says "Latency (p50)" which feels technical. Suggest "Typical latency" for surface, keep p50 in tooltip details.
Samir: +1. Also we should surface unit (ms) and sample size in tooltip: "Typical latency: 120ms (p50, n=482)".
Ana: Good call. For pin UX: current copy when pinning a version says "pin this variant". Feels vague — propose "Pin this model version for this project" and show an inline note about fallbacks if capacity limited.
Matt: UX nit: pinned rows should have a subtle icon + accessible name `aria-label="pinned model version"` and allow unpin from keyboard.
Jordan: Accessibility bot flagged contrast on performance badge — reddish background on small text fails AA for 12px. design-bot, can you paste the violation details?
design-bot: Accessibility check: element #perf-badge small-text contrast ratio 3.9:1 against #FF6B6B. Fails WCAG AA for size <14px. Recommendations: increase font-weight, use darker shade (#E04E4E) or add a 1px semi-transparent border.
Leah: Let's avoid color-only meaning for performance states. Add an icon (arrow up/down) and ensure color isn't the only signal. Also add `aria-label` like `Performance: typical 120ms (p50)`.
Carson: Action items: (a) keep separate chips, collapse after 5 with keyboard-accessible overflow; (b) badge surface copy -> "Typical latency"; tooltip contains `p50/p95` and sample size; (c) pin copy -> "Pin this model version for this project" and show fallback note; (d) fix contrast + add icon.
Samir: I'll update the Figma and push a compact-compare prototype. Will also add keyboard flow screenshots for Leah to test.
Ana: Timeline? Samir — can you share a link when ready? I want this in the next dev sprint tickets.
Samir: Will post link by EOD and add tickets to the sprint board. :thumbsup:
Ana: Thanks all — final decision summarized. :white_check_mark:
